entities.name: Hakaru Hashimoto
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hakaru Hashimoto  was a Japanese doctor and medical scientist of the Meiji and Taishō periods. He is best known for publishing the first description of the disease that was later named Hashimoto's thyroiditis.
